info.description: The Meeting Scheduling API enables organizations to effectively manage and schedule meetings with ease. This API allows users to create new meeting entries, including essential details such as time, participants, and agenda. Ideal for collaboration platforms and productivity tools, this endpoint caters to businesses aiming to streamline their meeting coordination processes. Typical consumers include application developers seeking to integrate scheduling functionalities into their services.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and schedule a new meeting by providing the required meeting details. Ensure all relevant information is included in the request body.

requestBody.description: Request body for scheduling a meeting. This must include essential details such as the meeting title, date, time, participants, and any additional notes.

201.description: A new meeting was successfully created.
